subject: Candidate feedback discrepancy & next steps for Sr. Infra Eng role
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate feedback discrepancy — Kevin Johnson (Sr. Infra Eng)

Mina/Neha —

I'm escalating a feedback discrepancy for Kevin Johnson (interview loop completed 2026-11-01). Two interviewers scored him high on systems design and operability, but the hiring panel notes say "insufficient ownership examples" and dropped the overall fit. The hiring team (me + Priyom) feel the panel misunderstood his prior role scope — Kevin led incident response and capacity planning at his last company; those examples are in his resume and in the attached notes.

We need HR to confirm the process for reconciling divergent feedback and whether we can proceed with a hiring manager appeal so we don't lose him — candidate is still active with recruiter. If appeal is reasonable, I'd like to propose moving him forward with a band-appropriate offer contingent on a short follow-up with the interviewers (15-min clarification).

Attachments: Kevin_Johnson_Resume.pdf, interview_notes_kj_20261101.pdf

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Eng Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate feedback discrepancy — Kevin Johnson (Sr. Infra Eng)

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the quick flag. A few notes from HR side:

- Process: we allow a hiring manager appeal when there is a material disagreement tied to factual evidence (resume, code sample, documented incident ownership). The manager should provide concrete examples and we run a rapid review with hiring committee chairs.
- Timing: we can complete the review within 48 business hours if we keep it focused.
- Options: 1) schedule a 15-min calibration call with the interviewers, 2) submit a written appeal packet (1 page + supporting notes), or 3) decide to proceed with a "finalist" offer pending a short reference check and a clarification call.

Please send the 1-page appeal summary by EOD and flag any interviewers who are unavailable for a 15-min call. I'll coordinate with Neha on comp alignment and Priyom on interview availability.

Also copying recruiting contact (Anna) so she knows we're evaluating next steps — we want to avoid candidate ghosting.

Mina Haddad
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Anna Park <anna@everspring.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate feedback discrepancy — Kevin Johnson (Sr. Infra Eng)

Following Mina's guidance, attached is a one-page appeal summary plus the annotated interview notes. Key points:

- Ownership examples: Kevin led the on-call rotation, rewrote the incident runbook, and shepherded a cross-team capacity project that reduced P99 latency by 22% — specific dates and stakeholders included in the notes.
- Interviewer calibration: two panelists focused heavily on hypothetical whiteboard questions and marked low when he asked for clarifying constraints; the manager team believes this undervalues production experience.
- Recommendation: schedule a 20-min calibration call with the two interviewers who scored him low and offer Kevin at band 5 with a $20k sign-on (benchmarked in comp_grid_v3.xlsx). Offer contingent on successful calibration or an alternate small takehome to demonstrate production ownership.

Attachments: interview_notes_kj_20261101.pdf, comp_grid_v3.xlsx

Marcus

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Anna Park <anna@everspring.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate feedback discrepancy — Kevin Johnson (Sr. Infra Eng)

Thanks all — quick update and decision:

1) We reviewed the appeal materials and the annotated notes. The evidence on ownership is clear and the discrepancy appears to stem from differences in evaluation emphasis (hypothetical problem-solving vs production ownership).
2) We approve a manager-initiated calibration call with the two interviewers. If the call resolves the concerns, proceed to an offer.
3) Compensation: band 5 with $180k base + $20k sign-on is approvable for this candidate. Priyom, please confirm budget availability; Marcus, please confirm you'll lead the calibration and keep the call to 20 mins.
4) Recruiter Anna — please hold candidate outreach until after the calibration call; do not extend an offer today. If call outcome is positive, we will route final offer through Neha for approvals and DocuSign.

I'll log this decision in the candidate record (link below) and mark timeline expectations: calibration call within 24 hours, final comp approval within 4 business hours after call.

Related links: https://hire.redwood.example/candidates/kevin-johnson

Neha Kapoor
Director, Talent & Rewards
Redwood Inference
